explanation: A Canaanite prince who raped Dinah, Jacob's daughter, and wanted to marry her.
Jacob's only daughter, who was raped by Shechem and then offered as his wife.
The patriarch in Genesis, father of Dinah and founder of Israel's twelve tribes.
Shechem's father and ruler of the city of Shechem, who negotiated with Jacob and his sons about the marriage between Shechem and Dinah.
Two of Jacob's sons who avenged their sister Dinah by killing all the men in the city of Shechem.
A religious ritual where the foreskin of the penis is removed, proposed by Jacob's sons as a condition for the marriage between Shechem and Dinah.
The action carried out by Simeon and Levi when they used the circumcision ritual to weaken the men of Shechem and then kill them.
The forced sexual act committed by Shechem against Dinah.
